title: finding(core): `toFilterNode` is a RENDER-time entry into a function with nine throw sites — an authored filter crashes the subtree, where the same filter on the query path reads as "malformed filter"
body:
Found by the `domain:ui` PM seat while reviewing PR objectui#9049 (card objectui#9001). ⛔ **Not claimed.** Grading, `priority:*` and `domain:*` are the triage seat's. ⚠️ This is deliberately **not** a finding against objectui#9049 — see "Why this is not that PR's defect".

## The class

`convertFiltersToAST` is designed to **refuse loudly**: measured on `origin/main`, it carries **nine** `throw new FilterOperatorError(...)` sites (`$regex`, `$not`, the retired lowercase aliases, three comparand shapes, and the combinator arms). That is the right shape for a producer deciding whether to send a query — `classifyLoadError` renders `INVALID_FILTER` / 400 as *"this filter is malformed"* rather than as a network fault, and the author sees a usable message.

`toFilterNode` delegates its **object** branch straight to it:

```ts
export function toFilterNode(source: unknown): FilterNode | Record<string, any> | undefined {
  ...
  return convertFiltersToAST(obj);
}
```

⚠️ **But `toFilterNode` is called during RENDER, on authored schema, inside `useMemo`** — not on the query path where `classifyLoadError` is waiting. Measured call sites (non-test, `origin/main`):

| site | what it lowers |
| :-- | :-- |
| `packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx` | `toFilterNode(filter)` in a `useMemo` |
| `packages/plugin-form/src/LineItemsPanel.tsx` | `toFilterNode(schema.filter)` in a `useMemo` |
| `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` | `toFilterNode(schemaFilterSource)` in a `useMemo` |
| `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` | `toFilterNode(schema.defaultFilters)` |

⇒ **One authored filter, two very different fates, decided by which entry point happens to reach it.** Through the data source it is a friendly "malformed filter". Through `schema.filter` it is a `FilterOperatorError` raised inside `useMemo` during render — which propagates as a render error and takes the subtree down, with no `classifyLoadError` in the path to translate it.

⚠️ Note the shape: this is the **same** "one input, two answers, decided by which path reached it" class as objectui#8568, objectui#8976 and objectui#9001 — but on the *delivery* axis rather than the acceptance axis.

## ⛔ Why this is not PR objectui#9049's defect

Stated explicitly so nobody re-files this as a regression of that PR:

- The nine throw sites are **all pre-existing**. objectui#9049 adds two more (`refuseTextComparand`), so it **joins** this class rather than creating it. objectui#8988's retired-alias refusals joined it earlier the same way.
- Measured over **4773** tracked authorable files: **19** mention `$icontains` at all (lit control), and the probe for an empty or non-string comparand returns hits **only** in tests, docblocks and prose — **zero** shipped app metadata authors one. Negative control dead.
- ⇒ For objectui#9049's two new shapes specifically the exposure is **latent in this repo**. What is not measurable from here is metadata a customer saved in a database, which is exactly the case PR objectui#9049's own author flagged when they declined to widen into the array branch: *"stored-view blast radius is a render-time throw on metadata an absent author saved."* ⭐ That reasoning was right — it just applies to the object branch too, and to the nine throws that were already there.

## What needs deciding

Not obvious, and ⛔ not this seat's to rule:

1. **Should `toFilterNode` catch?** It is documented as *"the last stop before the wire"*, which argues its callers meant the wire path. A `try`/`catch` returning `undefined` would turn a crash into a silently unconstrained query — ⚠️ which is the exact failure objectui#9001 just closed. So this is probably wrong.
2. **Should the render-time callers catch**, and render a visible "this view's filter is malformed" state? Honest, but it is four call sites and a new UI affordance.
3. **Should the authored filter be validated at save time** so a render-time throw is unreachable by construction? Largest, and the only one that removes the class rather than relocating it.

## Dedup

- Local: `git grep 'toFilterNode'` over `packages/**`, lit control the `plugin-grid` import line; the four `useMemo` sites above are the finding.
- objectui#9048 (filed from the same PR) is the **adjacent** card and ⛔ not this one: it is about two *producers* that still lower the bad node, i.e. the acceptance axis. This card is the delivery axis and applies to all nine pre-existing throws.

Filed by the `domain:ui` PM seat; session reference `https://claude.ai/code/session_01MPaVWWMuWeT5LgB1qoXjVB`.
